name: denorm_preserve
description: Gradual underflow for requested floating-point preservation modes.
cost_note: FP16 uses native half arithmetic. Requested FP32 add, multiply, FMA and divide use native operations with subnormal-operand and result guards, with exact software handling in out-of-line cold functions; other preservation operations retain their numerical helpers. FP64 uses software binary64.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires both FP32 denorm controls for SM 6.2 and higher; only shaders requesting the modes pay the cost, and DXC default fp32 denorm mode any requests neither.
off_consequence: Without either FP32 denorm control, vkd3d-proton limits non-NVIDIA D3D12 devices to SM 6.1; SM 6.2 and higher are unavailable.

name: denorm_flush
description: Flush subnormal results to zero in requested floating-point modes.
cost_class: native arithmetic / ALU fixups / cold software repair
cost_note: FP32 arithmetic remains native. Multiply, FMA and divide test a zero result and repair finite normal nonzero operands through a cold correctly rounded fallback before final subnormal flushing. Selected non-arithmetic operations retain exponent-mask fixups. FTZ16 and FTZ64 remain unsupported.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires both FP32 denorm controls for SM 6.2 and higher; only shaders requesting the modes pay the cost, and DXC default fp32 denorm mode any requests neither.
off_consequence: Without either FP32 denorm control, vkd3d-proton limits non-NVIDIA D3D12 devices to SM 6.1; SM 6.2 and higher are unavailable.

name: ray_tracing
description: Acceleration structures, ray queries and continuation-based ray-tracing pipelines.
cost_note: AS construction and traversal use compute and continuation dispatch. Work is selected by RT commands and shaders. Runtime cost is unmeasured.

property_bits.subgroupSupportedStages: VK_SHADER_STAGE_RAYGEN_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_ANY_HIT_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_CLOSEST_HIT_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_MISS_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_INTERSECTION_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_CALLABLE_BIT_KHR

performance_reason: Ray-tracing interfaces require explicit selection.
off_consequence: Vulkan acceleration-structure, ray-query and ray-tracing pipeline interfaces and D3D12 DXR are unavailable; the RTXPT DXR path cannot run.

name: pixel_interlock
description: Pixel interlock with cross-sample ordering for multisampled rendering.
cost_note: Sample interlock and single-sample pixel interlock use native raster order groups. Multisample pixel interlock captures coverage and inputs, then performs ordered load/replay/store passes in bounded tile and primitive batches with CPU/GPU continuation sequencing and scratch clearing. Cost scales with actual coverage, sample count and batch count; per-use runtime cost is unmeasured.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires pixel and sample interlock for ROV support and D3D FL12_1; the multisample envelope is selected only for shaders using pixel interlock with multisampling.
off_consequence: Pixel interlock is unavailable, including its native single-sample route; vkd3d-proton loses ROV support and D3D FL12_1. Native sample interlock and ordered color attachment access remain available.

name: pipeline_statistics
description: Pipeline-statistics queries backed by draw data and shader execution counters.
cost_note: An active fragment query adds a counter-address load and one 32-bit atomic increment, plus a carry atomic when the low word wraps. Other stages use draw data or instrumented execution. Inactive queries specialize the counter region away. Per-use timing is unmeasured.
performance_reason: Wine vkd3d requires pipelineStatisticsQuery for feature level 11_1 and above; inactive queries retain the false native specialization without counter operations.
off_consequence: Disabling pipelineStatisticsQuery limits Wine vkd3d to feature level 11_0 and removes pipeline-statistics queries; DXVK treats the feature as optional.

name: mesh_shader
description: Native object and mesh shaders with virtual task grids and sliced output when required.
cost_note: Unsliced direct mesh uses one native mesh render call. Virtual task batches add prepare, task and prefix compute followed by mesh rendering; output slicing and retained replay add selected captures and mesh draws. Queries add counters only when used. Per-use GPU instruction count and runtime cost are unmeasured.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires both meshShader and taskShader for D3D12 MeshTier1; disabling them removes feature-level 12.2 eligibility.
off_consequence: D3D12 MeshTier1 and feature-level 12.2 are unavailable; mesh/task Vulkan shaders and mesh queries are unavailable. Lower feature levels remain subject to their other requirements; this entry does not remove a shader-model requirement or a translator device-creation prerequisite.

name: polygon_points
description: Polygon POINT rasterization through captured primitive expansion.
cost_note: POINT emits two triangles per point after capture; FILL and eligible thin LINE draws retain native alternatives. Availability alone adds no shader code.
performance_reason: Preserve the non-solid fill feature selected by D3D translators; POINT cost is selected by actual polygon state.
off_consequence: Hides fillModeNonSolid and dynamic polygon mode, including native wireframe because Vulkan shares its feature bit with POINT; translator non-solid fill support is lost; SM and FL effects are not independently established.

name: line_expansion
description: Wide, rectangular, smooth and stippled Bresenham line rasterization.
cost_note: Selected wide/smooth/stipple lines capture vertices and emit expanded primitives; smooth lines add fragment alpha coverage and stipple adds dash generation. Thin default solid lines remain native.
performance_reason: Retain translator-selected line features until disabling them is established to preserve device creation and D3D feature levels; only actual expanded lines pay the cost.
off_consequence: Hides wide, rectangular, smooth and stippled Bresenham line features and their dynamic selectors; native thin Bresenham lines remain; SM/FL and translator device-creation neutrality are not established.

name: dynamic_coverage
description: Dynamic fragment sample mask and alpha-to-coverage lowering.
cost_note: Dynamic sample mask loads root state and filters coverage; nonconstant alpha-to-coverage computes a dither mask and demotes samples. Constant opaque alpha omits alpha coverage lowering. Rasterization sample count uses native attachment variants.
performance_reason: Preserve translator-selected dynamic coverage state; no evidence establishes device-creation neutrality when these controls are hidden.
off_consequence: Hides dynamic sample-mask and alpha-to-coverage selectors; static coverage and native dynamic rasterization sample count remain; SM/FL and translator device-creation neutrality are not established.

name: dynamic_vertex_input
description: Runtime vertex attribute descriptions and format conversion for dynamic vertex input.
cost_note: Dynamic vertex inputs load format, divisor and stride metadata for consumed attributes and perform format-dependent conversion; static pipelines retain constant attribute specialization. Unused inputs emit no fetch work.
performance_reason: DXVK and vkd3d-proton shader-model, feature-level and required device-creation checks do not require dynamic vertex-input state; static pipeline input remains available.
off_consequence: No D3D shader-model, feature-level or translator device-creation loss in the checked DXVK/vkd3d-proton paths; dynamic vertex-input pipelines must use static vertex layouts instead.

name: multiview_geometry_tessellation
description: Original-view replay for geometry and tessellation multiview producers.
cost_note: Advanced multiview producers execute for each active view using the original view index; single-view and ordinary native vertex amplification remain separate paths. Emitted producer instructions are repeated by view count, with a per-draw view load when used.
performance_reason: These advanced multiview combinations are not required by the checked D3D maximum shader-model, feature-level or translator device-creation predicates; ordinary multiview remains available.
off_consequence: No D3D maximum shader-model, feature-level or translator device-creation loss in checked paths; vkd3d-proton ViewInstancingTier can fall from tier 2 to unsupported when its advanced-multiview predicate requires these features.

name: quad_control
description: Full-quad helper invocation and quad derivative control around native quad operations.
cost_class: native quad operations / helper merge guard
cost_note: Native quad and subgroup instructions are retained. A shader requiring full or coarse quad helper invocations can add the existing barycentric triangle-merge guard, or a sample-mask output when no color store exists; unused helper requirements emit neither guard.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires shaderQuadControl together with maximal reconvergence to advance from SM 6.6 to SM 6.7 and later; only affected fragment requirements select the helper guard.
off_consequence: vkd3d-proton cannot expose SM 6.7 or later through its ordinary quad-control/reconvergence path when the earlier SM 6.6 requirements are satisfied; no additional feature-level or device-creation loss is established.

name: texel_buffer_alignment
description: Single-texel-offset buffer views over aligned native textures and raw buffer addresses.
cost_note: Typed native buffer access adds logical range comparison, prefix addition and invalid-coordinate selection; dynamic RGB32 views also select stride and fetch consumed components. Raw/R64 and sparse accesses retain required range and residency work. Unused shaders emit no texel-view code. Runtime cost is unmeasured.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires both single-texel alignment promises for D3D12 device creation at the supported 16-byte native alignment; only shaders accessing texel-buffer views pay the adjustment cost.
off_consequence: vkd3d-proton v3.1 rejects D3D12 device creation when either single-texel alignment promise is absent at 16-byte alignment, making all D3D12 feature levels unavailable.

name: cull_distance
description: Whole-primitive rejection from cull distances written by the final pre-raster shader.
cost_note: Mesh shaders use native primitive rejection. Ordinary producers writing cull distances use capture and an all-vertex negative test per plane before clipping; each tested vertex loads one scalar distance, and testing stops at the first nonnegative or NaN value. No cull output selects no cull capture. GPU time is unmeasured.
performance_reason: DXVK requires shaderCullDistance for translator device creation; capture is selected only by actual final-producer cull output.
off_consequence: DXVK cannot create its D3D device without shaderCullDistance; Vulkan cull-distance shader support is unavailable.

name: non_seamless_cube
description: Face-local cube sampling without filtering across cube faces.
cost_note: Dynamic cube samples use the shared sampler-emulation function constant; the false specialization retains native cube sampling. Actual non-seamless use projects to a 2D-array face sample with quotient-rule gradients.
performance_reason: Disabling has no established D3D shader-model, feature-level or translator device-creation loss; content requiring legacy non-seamless cube sampling can opt in.
off_consequence: No established D3D shader-model or feature-level reduction or translator device-creation loss; DXVK rejects content requesting non-seamless cube sampling.

name: sparse_translation
description: Sparse-buffer residency checks and standard-shaped 3D sparse image adaptation.
cost_class: native placement / software address and volume translation
cost_note: Native placement and mapping remain native. The scalar buffer page-status helper emits three 64-bit metadata loads, two byte-status loads, bounds checks and a conditional branch, in addition to directory/range lookup and the resource access. Standard-shaped 3D accesses translate coordinates and select page storage, with copies or blits on relevant operations. Unused shader operations emit no translation. Per-use GPU time is unmeasured.
performance_reason: DXVK requires sparse buffer residency for tiled resources; removing it can lower the D3D feature-level ceiling. Translation is selected by actual sparse resources and shader interfaces.
off_consequence: Sparse buffer residency and sparse 3D image residency are unavailable, including standard-shaped 3D blocks; DXVK tiled-resource tiers and feature levels requiring them are unavailable. Native sparse binding, aliasing, 2D residency and native texture residency status remain available when supported.

name: robustness2
description: Exact out-of-bounds buffer and image access behavior and null descriptors.
cost_class: native access / bounds and null guards
cost_note: Selected bounded buffer loads use bounds predicates and zero/default selection; selected image and null accesses use guards. Unused operations emit no checks. Runtime cost is unmeasured.
performance_reason: DXVK 2.x/3.x requires VK_EXT_robustness2 and nullDescriptor for device creation and uses robustBufferAccess2/robustImageAccess2; vkd3d-proton also requires nullDescriptor. Required buffer bounds and null semantics remain enabled.
off_consequence: DXVK 2.x/3.x and vkd3d-proton device creation fails when required nullDescriptor/robustness2 support is hidden. Both extension aliases and their three features are hidden; core robustness and pipeline robustness remain available.

name: workgroup_zero
description: Zero initialization of shader workgroup memory when requested by the shader.
cost_note: A requested nonempty shared allocation is rounded to 16 bytes and cooperatively cleared with native stores followed by a workgroup barrier. No clear or barrier is emitted without the shader zero-init flag and nonzero shared size. Runtime cost is unmeasured.
performance_reason: Workgroup initialization is required by translator shader semantics; retain it for DXVK/vkd3d device creation and shader translation. Shaders without requested shared initialization emit no zeroing stores or barriers.
off_consequence: DXVK/vkd3d device creation fails when required workgroup-zero support is unavailable; the extension and promoted shaderZeroInitializeWorkgroupMemory feature are hidden. Allocation zero initialization and robustness are unchanged.

name: depth_bias_control
description: Exact and alternate-representation depth bias after primitive clipping.
cost_class: native default / geometry capture and replay
cost_note: Default format-dependent bias uses Metal state. Selected exact or alternate representations capture geometry, run shared polygon compute and replay rasterization after clipping. Static disabled/default-bias pipelines retain native shaders; dynamic factors can retain capture/native siblings. Runtime cost is unmeasured.
performance_reason: DXVK and vkd3d-proton treat depth-bias control as optional; disabling it does not lower their shader model or feature level or prevent device creation.
off_consequence: No D3D shader-model, feature-level or translator-device-creation loss in DXVK or vkd3d-proton; exact and alternate-representation Vulkan depth bias is unavailable and translators retain their default bias path.

name: float64
description: Binary64 floating-point arithmetic and comparisons.
cost_note: Only actual FP64 operations are lowered to integer and FP32 algorithms; equality uses branchless 32-bit integer operations. FP32 and integer-only shaders emit no FP64 code. Runtime cost is unmeasured.
performance_reason: Double precision is an optional D3D11/D3D12 capability; the pinned DXVK and vkd3d-proton SM/FL and device-creation gates do not require it, and Apple family 8 has no native binary64 ALU.
off_consequence: D3D11/D3D12 double-precision capabilities and FP64 shader creation are unavailable; the pinned translator SM/FL limits and ordinary device creation are unchanged. Integer64 support is independent.

name: device_generated_commands
description: Generated graphics and compute sequences with push-data and vertex/index-buffer tokens.
cost_class: GPU token expansion / native Metal ICB
cost_note: Used sequences snapshot token bytes and expand root, draw and vertex-input data on the GPU before native ICB execution. Native expansion and command encoding share one dispatch per 512-sequence slice; graphics crosses from compute to render. Poly stages retain their own expansion. The shared runtime library is compiled only for generated-command or indirect-count execution; application shaders gain no DGC MSL.
performance_reason: Keeps state-changing D3D12 ExecuteIndirect signatures working where vkd3d-proton has no complete fallback; unused DGC adds no application-shader MSL or GPU preprocessing.
off_consequence: ExecuteIndirect tier 1.1 is unavailable; vkd3d-proton can skip state-changing indirect signatures without a DGC template. No shader-model or feature-level reduction or device-creation rejection is established for DGC alone.

name: draw_indirect_count
description: GPU-counted ordinary multi-draw indirect commands.
cost_class: GPU count filtering / native Metal ICB
cost_note: Large native batches expand active draw records and encode ICB commands in one dispatch per 512-draw slice. Other selected routes filter indirect arguments on the GPU and retain their own stage work. Counts remain GPU-resident. No count command adds application-shader MSL. The shared maxDrawIndirectCount limit also serves native fixed-count draws and is retained.
performance_reason: Preserves D3D12 counter-backed ExecuteIndirect and predication semantics; vkd3d-proton returns without executing these commands if drawIndirectCount is unavailable.
off_consequence: Counter-buffer and fallback-predicated ExecuteIndirect commands are skipped by vkd3d-proton. Its reported shader model and feature level can remain unchanged and no device-creation rejection is established; those reports do not provide the missing command semantics.

name: fragment_barycentric
description: Fragment barycentric coordinates and per-vertex inputs.
cost_note: Legal center-only coordinates use native barycentric_coord. A representative float4 corner interpolation emits 4 fragment input reads and 20 scalar arithmetic assignments; its producer emits 155 temporary assignments versus 3 for the ordinary producer. Exact or reordered coordinates retain corner transport. These are emitted MSL counts; GPU timing is unmeasured.
performance_reason: Preserves SM 6.1 barycentric shader support and the barycentric requirement of vkd3d-proton mesh shaders, which are required for feature level 12.2.
off_consequence: Without a translator fallback, SV_Barycentrics shaders are unavailable and vkd3d-proton normally disables mesh shaders; this prevents feature level 12.2 when its other requirements are met. The maximum reported shader model is not independently reduced by this entry.

name: sampler_filter_minmax
description: Minimum and maximum sampler filtering on Apple8 and Apple9 GPUs.
cost_note: Apple10 uses native sampler reduction. Apple8 and Apple9 reduce up to 2^dimensions point taps per filtered mip, with up to two mip footprints and additional anisotropic footprints. Immutable MIN/MAX helpers omit weighted-result dispatch and inline internal taps; ordinary weighted sampling keeps its native path.
performance_reason: DXVK uses min/max filtering for tiled-resource tier 2, which is required for D3D feature level 12_0; only samplers selecting reduction perform software taps.
off_consequence: Disabling min/max filtering can lower DXVK tiled-resource support below tier 2 and remove D3D feature level 12_0.

name: descriptor_heap
description: Descriptor heap addressing and shared image, buffer and sampler metadata.
cost_note: In emitted non-sparse, unrobust signatures, a buffer access uses one 8-byte heap-root load and one 16-byte packet load; a sampled texture/sampler pair uses two 8-byte heap-root loads plus one 8-byte sampler-metadata pointer load before shared decoding. Unused set shaders emit no heap access. GPU latency and relative speed are unmeasured.
performance_reason: Pinned DXVK and vkd3d-proton retain conventional descriptor binding, device creation and D3D SM/FL without this optional interface; no relative speedup is claimed.
off_consequence: Pinned DXVK/vkd3d-proton device creation and D3D SM/FL are unchanged; the Vulkan heap interface and vkd3d experimental work graphs are unavailable, and byte-offset views require descriptor-buffer support.

name: zero_initialize_device_memory
description: Explicit zero contents for requested device-memory allocations and ZERO_INITIALIZED images.
cost_note: Each flagged allocation clears the whole BO with CPU stores or a Metal buffer fill and completion wait. ZERO_INITIALIZED images use unoptimized storage to preserve zero bits. No shader instructions are added.
performance_reason: DXVK 3.1.1 and vkd3d-proton 3.1 do not require this allocation extension for D3D shader models, feature levels or device creation; vkd3d-proton retains its resource-clearing path.
off_consequence: D3D shader-model, feature-level and translator device-creation support remain; explicit Vulkan zero-initialized allocation requests and ZERO_INITIALIZED image layout are unavailable.
